title: Enantiomer pair and chiral observation boundary
statement: Enantiomers are the paired complete stereoisomer carriers related by exact reflection and by no identity-preserving proper superposition, with opposed configurations retained.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the eight registered binary coordinates; decide every form by complete carrier preservation, exact equivalence enumeration, minimality and absence of an extra rule.
grammar_boundary: Every finite pair of equal-composition, equal-connectivity oriented molecular carriers with exhaustive mirror and proper-superposition tests.
